newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs Tuesday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Tuesday, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York confirmed.
The action was not entirely unexpected, though some economists had called for the Fed to stay out of the banking system this session.
Fed funds were trading at 5-5/16 percent, slightly above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate, and right where they where trading prior to the operation.
(( -- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury desk 212-859-1663))
